use_cases: Hero section headline with stacked animated text that responds to hover
Landing page section header with parallax-style layered text reveal
Feature showcase with animated text labels that slide on interaction
Portfolio or creative site header with sophisticated text animation
Marketing page intro with progressive text reveal on user engagement
ai_summary: A layered text component that displays stacked text lines with GSAP-powered hover animations. Multiple text layers shift vertically with staggered timing, creating a parallax-like reveal effect. Ideal for hero sections and impactful headlines where motion adds engagement without visual clutter.
